trajectory_summary: The call starts warm and stays cooperative throughout — Karen volunteers a lot (widowhood, skepticism, tech struggle, budget ceiling) and the rep gets the appointment booked. But the rep repeatedly fails to pick up the anchors she hands him: the widow/bill-pain line, the $2.50-to-$800 seasonal swing, and her explicit debt-free/no-cost boundary all go unflipped and unreinforced. Energy is mixed — it builds through her openness but leaks through the rep's missed hooks and disorganized script execution.
